text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Milers Cup. Daitaku Helios 
was straight-up god-tier. The vibe was 
simply immaculate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's shining so brightly that Daiichi 
Ruby won't be able to look away. With her 
vibes through the roof, she takes on the 
race.
